reviews.review: Like a faster, more comprehensible Gunfire Reborn. Class upgrade synergies feel really powerful and every gun feels viable to use. Also the best soundtrack I've heard in a game like this. Give the demo a try if you're on the fence!
it has amazing music and a lot of unique enemies as well as awesome weapon options... and you get to defeat an AI overlord who took over earth on the moon, I mean whats not to like
Guys will see this game and say "hell yeah"
